previous.changeLog: Major Vehicle Characteristics overhaul with mode support, expanded configuration-aware stats, detailed perk/equipment/consumable/directive attribution, improved tooltips and layouts, complete translations, and numerous calculation and display fixes.

current.changeLog:
Added a Loadout Sandbox for equipment, directives, consumables, crew perks, boosted slots and field modifications.
Added standard, bounty, upgraded bounty, bond and experimental equipment variants with compatibility restrictions.
Added complete crew customization, including shared, role-specific, secondary-role and conditional perks.
Added Restore Loadout and Remove All controls.
Improved sandbox layout, artwork, dragging, transparency and state preservation.
Corrected boosted-slot bonuses, shell velocity, Intuition time, and vehicle-specific damage calculations for tanks including the Taschenratte and PTZ-78.
Corrected misleading baseline and fractional values.
Greatly reduced freezing when opening statistics or recalculating configurations.
Fixed missing +/- bonus labels after fast loading.
Numerous UI, tooltip, accuracy and compatibility fixes.

previous.changeLog: Added support for onslaught maps and fixed some bugs.

current.changeLog: Fixed the wrong hangar occasionally loading on the first game launch. Fixed tanks appearing at the incorrect location in Exterior/Customization until after playing a battle. Improved compatibility with active event hangars. Improved restoration of the original hangar when entering native game views.
Häufigkeit der Sounds wurde reduziert durch das hinzufügen von neuen Sounds

previous.changeLog: Improved compatibility between 3D styles and custom decals, emblems, and inscriptions. Custom overlays are now preserved when replacing a 3D style with 2D customization, and compatible unowned 3D styles can be used locally. Added optional descriptions for custom assets and improved support for branded vehicles such as the Rheinmetall Skorpion G. Also fixed invalid styles, errors when entering Custom mode from certain 3D styles, and unnecessary error reports caused by shared-battle connection timeouts.

current.changeLog: Fixed 3D attachments not updating correctly in Exterior. Improved 3D style and customization-item compatibility. Prevented invalid outfit data from causing preview or rendering errors. Improved Purchase & Exit safety checks. Added descriptions for custom assets.
